topics.title: xAI launches Grok Voice 3.0
topics.why: It just topped the speech-AI leaderboard and is already running Tesla's in-car voice and Starlink's support line, proof voice agents are now real customer-facing infrastructure, not demos.

topics.title: NVIDIA drops Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a free 120B agent model
topics.why: It's open-weight and claims 5x the speed of similarly sized rivals, which pushes powerful multimodal agents within reach of teams who can't afford frontier-lab API bills.

topics.title: Manus's parent company raises $500M+ after its Meta deal fell apart
topics.why: Butterfly Effect just went independent again after Meta's reported $2B+ acquisition unwound, a reminder of how fast AI M&A can reverse and how much capital is still chasing agent startups.
